shoot.prompt: One punchy arcade projectile shot: a sharp dry crack with a solid midrange pop and a very short descending zap, immediate attack, powerful compact sound lasting 0.2 seconds, isolated on silence, no echoes, repeated shots, music or voices.

enemy_death.prompt: One small fantasy creature vanishing in a soft crunchy pop and fluttering dust puff, playful satisfying impact with a short falling tail under half a second, isolated on silence, no voice or music.

boss_roar.prompt: One deep menacing fantasy beast growl, rough resonant throaty rumble swelling into a powerful short roar then dying away in two seconds, isolated on silence, no speech or music.

boss_warning.prompt: A single ominous rising wind rush, low hollow turbulent air swelling toward a heavy arrival, brief two-second sound effect isolated on silence, no music or voices.

boss_burst.prompt: One large fantasy shell exploding into brittle fragments, weighty low impact and crunchy crackling debris trailing away for one second, isolated on silence, no music or voices.

boss_charge.prompt: One tense rising magical energy charge, resonant airy whirl tightening upward in pitch for half a second with a clean ending, isolated on silence, no music.

boss_volley.prompt: One heavy magical projectile launching, deep rubbery thump and quick rasping air rush with a short tail, isolated on silence, no music or voices.

flap.prompt: One quick small bird wingbeat, soft feathery flutter and a light air swish, dry close-up, brief quarter-second sound isolated on silence, no chirping or music.

finish_snap.prompt: One taut elastic ribbon tape snapping in two, a crisp bright snap with a short springy rubbery twang that wobbles away, close-mic, dry, isolated on silence, no music or voices.
finish_snap.use: The first 0.9 s (its snap and the ring after it; a second snap at 0.6 s is faded out). finish_foley() in tool/prepare_sound_effects.py adds the twang, the two poppers and the confetti.

rejected.prompt: Two party poppers popping in quick succession, crisp papery pops, then a short shower of confetti paper fluttering and rustling down, close-mic, isolated on silence, no music or voices.
rejected.reason: Starts mid-decay with a -22 dBFS peak: one dull 200-370 Hz thump, no two distinct pops and no rustle. The poppers and confetti are synthesised instead (popper, crinkle, band_noise).

finish_cheer.prompt: A few little birds chirping happily at once, quick separate chirps and tweets, short two-note whistles, bursts of fluttering wings, bright and cheerful, close, isolated on silence.
finish_cheer.use: The first 2.3 s: chirping bursts at 0, 0.38-0.66, 0.88-1.08, 1.1-1.4 and 1.56-1.84 s with near-silent gaps between, a whistle line at 2.4-4.5 kHz. finish_foley() adds two whistled wheet-whoos in the gaps and fades it from 0.9 s.

rejected.reason: Builds from -45 dB over its first second and is loudest at the end; the cheer must be loudest as the bird crosses.

rejected.prompt: A small flock of happy cartoon songbirds chirping and tweeting excitedly together, bright cheerful two-note whistles, a light flutter of wings, joyful and playful, close, isolated on silence, no music, no people.
rejected.reason: One continuous warbling whistle for all 3 s (a strong tone in 98-99% of 20 ms frames), the first a slow siren-like 1.6-3.7 kHz sweep, with no gaps to leave a spoken line room.

shoot.prompt: One short cartoon pebble spat through the air, crisp hollow wooden pop with a tight airy zip, dry close-up, fast attack and decay within 0.25 seconds, isolated on silence, no music.

synthesised.note: Original deterministic syntheses: no source takes, no network, no ElevenLabs. Each cue is one branch of synth() in tool/prepare_sound_effects.py, mastered by master() to a -3.10 dBFS peak (coo_roar, gargoyle_awaken and gargoyle_strike also to a soft-knee RMS target) as mono 44.1 kHz signed 16-bit PCM, and is reproducible byte for byte. Refresh the files entries after a re-render with `python3 tool/check_sound_effects.py --update-sources`; `--verify-sources` fails on a mismatch.

new_york.command: python3 tool/prepare_sound_effects.py --only pigeon_coo pigeon_flap pigeon_snatch pigeon_defeat star_rescue steam_hiss steam_burst pipe_clang steam_ride gargoyle_strike gargoyle_awaken beam_warning beam_sweep beam_spot lamp_vent lamp_glance feather_drop coo_roar coo_whistle crumb_throw crumb_splat squad_flutter coo_puff coo_pop coo_defeat coo_shout gargoyle_fury gargoyle_shatter coo_inflate

mastering.dc_block: master(dc_block=True) for every New York cue

pigeon_coo.fires_on: CombatAudioCues: FlightSimulation.pigeonWarnings rises (each pigeon's 0.80 s warning)
pigeon_coo.takes: take 2 is a whole tone (x1.1225) higher

pigeon_flap.takes: take 2 shifts every clap 4 ms later and reseeds

pigeon_defeat.fires_on: CombatAudioCues: FlightSimulation.pigeonsDefeated rises (replaces enemy_death for pigeons)
pigeon_defeat.takes: take 2 is a whole tone higher

steam_hiss.fires_on: CombatAudioCues: FlightSimulation.steamHisses rises (vent within birdX-0.1 .. birdX+1.8)
steam_hiss.fix_round: 1.5 s (was 1.4 s) to fill the vent's whole warning, with a sixth knock at 1.40 s

steam_burst.fires_on: CombatAudioCues: FlightSimulation.steamBursts rises, together with pipe_clang
steam_burst.takes: take 2 reseeds every layer and raises the clang 7%

gargoyle_strike.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the reveal edge (age 1.65 s) of the Searchlight Gargoyle, in place of boss_reveal

gargoyle_awaken.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the roar edge (age 2.65 s) of the Searchlight Gargoyle, in place of boss_roar

beam_sweep.fires_on: BossAudioCues: SkyBoss.sweepIgnitions rises (cycle second 3.5; lasts to the vent at 6.4)

beam_spot.fires_on: BossAudioCues: SkyBoss.spots rises (the bird is caught in the beam)

lamp_glance.fires_on: BossAudioCues: SkyBoss.lastGlanceAt advances (a rock glances off the shuttered lamp)

feather_drop.takes: take 2 shifts the rustle up 10% and the tick 12%

coo_roar.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the roar edge (age 2.65 s) and the fury edge of King Coo, in place of boss_roar / boss_enrage

coo_whistle.fires_on: BossAudioCues: SkyBoss.whistles rises (the rules blow the whistle at cycle second 9.2)
coo_whistle.fix_round: the long blast now starts at 0.12 s (was 0.30 s) and the cue is 0.85 s (was 1.0 s), so it sounds while the 0.4 s blast pose is on

crumb_throw.fires_on: BossAudioCues: SkyBoss.lobsLaunched rises (the bomb is tossed)
crumb_throw.fix_round: re-synthesised in the mids: a 1.7 kHz swish, a lighter thwup and crinkle grains (was whoosh, thump, crumble); band 31% -> 84%

crumb_splat.fix_round: re-synthesised in the mids: a soft pop, a 1.4 kHz wet slap and 18 crinkle grains; band 26% -> 75%

squad_flutter.fires_on: BossAudioCues: with every coo_whistle, and again for a fury picket (SquadPlan.delay seconds later)

coo_defeat.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the defeat burst edge (0.85 s after defeat) of King Coo, in place of boss_burst

coo_shout.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the roar edge (age 2.65 s) of King Coo, in place of coo_roar (which is now his fury's); 0.85 s to his beak's 0.8 s swell

gargoyle_fury.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the Gargoyle's fury edge (hp <= 80), in place of the generic boss_enrage (phone-silent: 0.2% of its energy in 250 Hz-8 kHz)

gargoyle_shatter.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the burst edge (0.85 s after the defeat) of the Gargoyle, in place of the generic boss_burst (6% in band)

coo_inflate.fires_on: BossAudioCues: King Coo's defeat at +0.12 s (the end of the hit-stop), the chest inflating until the pop at +0.85 s

levels.note: Cues that are another cue's WAV at another level (SoundSpec.file): the cue layer plays a steam burst and its clang ducked, and a snatch lifted, when a snatch and a burst land within 0.3 s of each other. tool/prepare_sound_effects.py renders nothing for them.

finish_line.note: The campaign finish line. finish_near and finish_swoop are original syntheses; finish_snap and finish_cheer start from the ElevenLabs takes under sources (they need build/sound-effects/source/finish_snap_tape.mp3 and finish_cheer.mp3) and are listed here so --verify-sources checks their mastered files too. All four are master()ed with dc_block; finish_snap also to a soft-knee RMS target of -19 dB. The complete fanfare that plays between them is unchanged.
finish_line.command: python3 tool/prepare_sound_effects.py --only finish_near finish_snap finish_cheer finish_swoop

finish_near.fires_on: 2.6 s before the crossing, as the gate's marquee lights flick on and chase

finish_snap.fires_on: at the crossing (t = 0): the snap peaks 13 ms in, the poppers at 40 and 90 ms; the picture's tape snaps and cannons fire at 75 ms, after the 75 ms hit-stop

finish_cheer.fires_on: at t = 0.12 s; the music ducks to 0.45 of its level for its 2.3 s (SoundSpec.duck)

finish_swoop.fires_on: at t = 1.15 s as the bird swoops to the result cloud; the fwump at 0.55 s lands with it at t = 1.70 s

egypt.command: python3 tool/prepare_sound_effects.py --only hoopoe_roar sand_devil mail_call letter_flick letter_return postage_due wrap_scuff ankh_raise ankh_whir ankh_catch mummy_fury mask_pop lost_letter

seed_ranges.finish_line: 501-549: landed alongside Egypt; a seed only seeds one call's noise, so a shared number repeats a noise texture and nothing else

egypt.design: egypt-ws/reports/01-egypt-guardian.md section 6; prototype proof/mummy_cues_prototype.py (twelve of the thirteen WAVs are byte-identical to the prototype's; hoopoe_roar is re-timed to the picture's beak pulses and played at volume .65 instead of .55)

hoopoe_roar.fires_on: the roar edge (boss age 2.65 s), in place of boss_roar, and again at the full fight's stage-up (stageReached 0 to 1, a 1.4 s roar)

sand_devil.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: boss age 0.1 s of the arrival (a first frame up to 0.6 s counts)

letter_flick.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: each letter whose releaseAt has come while he attacks (1.6 s + .40 s k; fury .32 s)

letter_return.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: NeferhooFight.lettersReturned rises (a rock catches a letter; a bulk return is one cue)

postage_due.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: NeferhooFight.returnsLanded rises (a returned letter lands for 25)

wrap_scuff.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: NeferhooFight.wrapScuffs rises (a rock on the wraps); as wrap_scuff_duck within 0.25 s of a postage due

ankh_raise.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: NeferhooFight.ankhLockedAt rises (cycle second 5.4, only when the signature lock really happens)

ankh_whir.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: each ankh whose thrownAt has come while he attacks (6.8 s; fury's second 0.5 s later shares the 2 s cooldown)

mummy_fury.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the fury edge (hp*3 <= maxHp), in place of boss_enrage

mask_pop.fires_on: BossAudioCues: the burst edge (0.85 s after the defeat), in place of boss_burst

lost_letter.fires_on: NeferhooAudioCues: 1.6 s after the defeat (the lost letter glows), 0.05 s behind boss_victory

levels.note: The scuff under a postage due is the scuff's WAV 6 dB lower (SoundSpec.file): NeferhooAudioCues plays it when a scuff lands within 0.25 s of a postage due. tool/prepare_sound_effects.py renders nothing for it.
